now.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
now.text: Trevor, kept by Wenwu as a jester, helps Shang-Chi reach Ta Lo, then goes off on his own.

proposed.text: Trevor, kept by Wenwu as a jester, helps Shang-Chi reach Ta Lo, then stays there with Morris.

changes.evidence: At the end of Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Trevor decides to stay in Ta Lo with Morris (he only leaves Ta Lo for Los Angeles in Wonder Man episode 2). He does not go off on his own.

now.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
now.text: Held by Wenwu for years, Trevor befriends Shang-Chi with his hundun Morris and helps him fight.
cases: ST-087 The Battle of Ta Lo (Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings)

proposed.text: Held by Wenwu for years, Trevor befriends Shang-Chi, and he and his hundun Morris guide him to Ta Lo.

changes.evidence: Trevor and Morris guide Shang-Chi's group to Ta Lo. In the Battle of Ta Lo, Trevor lies low, avoids fighting and plays dead with Morris, so 'helps him fight' is wrong.

now.title: Item 47
now.text: Blake hunts Bennie and Claire after they steal a Chitauri gun, then recruits them to S.H.I.E.L.D.

proposed.text: Blake and Sitwell are assigned to recover a Chitauri gun that Bennie and Claire use to rob banks. Sitwell recruits the couple to S.H.I.E.L.D. instead, and Claire becomes Blake's assistant.

changes.evidence: In Item 47, it is Sitwell who tracks down the couple and recruits them, to Blake's displeasure; Claire is made Blake's assistant. The couple find the discarded gun, they don't steal it.
